set.body: Run OASIS/LPBA40-style labeled evaluation and shifted-site cases with labels excluded from optimization. Record Dice/surface Dice, TRE where available, det-J distribution and folds, inverse composition error, runtime, peak memory, accepted/rejected steps, and per-kernel profiles. Compare against a frozen fair ANTs SyN command and require statistical parity before any superiority claim.
set.title: HalfFlow 7: labeled-cohort validation and performance hardening
